verifiedContracts: Actual GuideStatsLegend SSR emits readable copy, native summary and Help before hydration. A held hydration entry permits opening the disclosure before JS; actual mount effect admits the already-open disclosure. Real Term/InfoTip/Popover are absent from every initial static client ESM closure.

Unmodified real loadGuideLegendTerm imports the actual split Term chunk only after native opening. Held loading, closing before settlement, reopening, actual definition/Help/Escape and stable focus pass. Real held deadline retires the old attempt; explicit retry sharing the pending ESM fetch admits only current completion and restores the ready trigger.

Explicitly labelled controlled transport promises exercise repeated rejection, retry rejection focus, retry deadline focus, late timed-out resolution retirement and later success. The actual GuideLikelyRangeTerm, timers, Term, InfoTip, Popover and Modal are unchanged; only loader transport settlement is injected in these cases.

Closed disclosure and newer actual Modal retain focus when retry resolves; no tip auto-opens. Loading/failure/full help text remains intact. Parent source review found and author fixed retry-failure focus with two focused regressions before runtime verification.
Every browser request is intercepted and unexpected origins/methods fail. No account/API/provider/persistence/native operation is used.

failedEvidence.cause: Reviewer incorrectly used Testing Library hidden:true in a Playwright role query; Playwright expects includeHidden:true. Unknown option was ignored, so a correctly rendered control inside closed details was excluded.

Focused diagnostic preserved actual hidden DOM with exact aria-label/haspopup/expanded and zero page/request errors. Corrected fixture to physical exact aria-label/count while closed, retaining real accessible role/name checks after reopening. No product source or failing assertion removed.

limits: Actual React SSR/component hydration proof is isolated, not Next RSC/HTTP streaming/status/authentication proof. The standalone client compiles the actual server legend for hydration, including server copy helpers; this is not evidence of Next route bundle bytes or its RSC data split. Root actual Next build/all83 caps is the authority for those.

Native ESM caches rejected module loads differently from Next webpack runtime. Repeated rejected-load→success cases are explicitly labelled transport seams and do not claim native ESM network rejection recovery. Real loader success/held/deadline cases have no loader adapter.

Playwright clock advancement exercises the actual8-second component deadline; it does not replace completion or focus logic. Full AA scans do not claim actual screen-reader speech. No Randomizer rerun or audio/native proof is claimed.

Root owns build03/budgets/postasset receipts, unit/types/lint, source delivery/CI/deployment and roadmap ledger. Source-ready is the preserved preverification snapshot despite its pending-state wording.

cleanup.evidence: Playwright runner completed normally. No local server exists in this fixture; all assets intercepted. No OS-wide inventory or broad process kill claimed.

visualInspection.result: Real tooltip and Learn more link are readable and contained at320px and desktop; native legend copy, summary and Help stay readable around the nonmodal popover. No clipped controls or horizontal overflow observed.
